description: Located on the 4th floor with a lift in one of the most prestigious areas of the 16th arrondissement, this luxurious apartment can accommodate up to 8 people in an elegant and refined setting. Four large bedrooms with double beds, three bathrooms, a spacious living room with a dining table for 8, and a fully equipped kitchen: every detail has been thought out to ensure an exceptional stay. A stone's throw from the Rue de la Pompe metro station and the Trocadéro.The spaceThe apartment4th floor with an elevatorUp to 8 guests- Bedroom 1: Double bed- Bedroom 2: Double bed- Bedroom 3: Double bed- Bedroom 4: double bed- Large living room: sofa, TV, dining table for 8 people- 3 modern bathrooms- Fully equipped kitchen: oven, microwave, washing machine, coffee machine, toaster, cookware, full set of dishes- Wifi-Towels and bed linen are providedGuest accessNeighbourhood and transportPrestigious residential area in the 16th arrondissement, a stone's throw from Avenue Foch.- Rue de la Pompe metro station (line 9): 2 minutes' walk- Victor Hugo metro station (line 2): 5 minutes' walk- Trocadéro: 12 minutes on foot- Eiffel Tower: 15 minutes on foot- Bois de Boulogne: 10 minutes on foot- Champs Elysees: 10 min by MetroOther things to noteWe would like to inform you that check-ins are possible between 4pm and 9pm.Even in case of self check-in, our team can be reached by message in the evening if there is any need. However, after 9pm, we will not be able to guarantee immediate intervention or instant resolution of any problem related to check-in, access to the accommodation or an on-site issue.We appreciate your understanding and remain at your disposal to best prepare for your arrival. – hotel-type listing
